pr_title: Move Sonos bass & treble controls to number entities
pr_body:
<!--

## Breaking change
<!--
  If your PR contains a breaking change for existing users, it is important
  to tell them what breaks, how to make it work again and why we did this.
  This piece of text is published with the release notes, so it helps if you
  write it towards our users, not us.
  Note: Remove this section if this PR is NOT a breaking change.
-->
The `sonos.set_option` service has been removed along with the `bass_level` and `treble_level` attributes on `media_player` entities. Controls for bass and treble adjustments have been moved to dedicated `number` entities.

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Move the bass and treble adjustment controls from an integration-specific service and attributes on the `media_player` entity to dedicated `number` entities.

issue_context.title: Sonos bass_level & treble_level attribute update
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Since I never paid attention to the bass_level and treble_level attributes of my Sonos speakers in HA before, I now notice that they don’t update when I change them using the Sonos App or using a service-call in HA. I am not sure since when. The levels that they show where once true.

One can hear the levels change acoustically and when changed using the service-call, they do update in the Sonos app but never in HA. Other changes, like volume, content, queue_position, etc “sync” perfectly fine.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.11.5

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

unknown

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Sonos

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/sonos

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
No relevant log data under config -> logs or superviser -> system (core)
```


### Additional information

The speakers, HA and device(s) that run the Sonos app are all in different (V)LANs. Since everything else is working perfectly fine, I however don't thing that's the issue. Since everything I need is working fine, it's no urgent thing to me but I wanted you to be informed about it.
